caption: The drawing depicts a detailed rendering of a single cowboy spur with its attached leather strap. The spur portion is metallic, illustrated in shades of gray and silver, featuring intricate engraved patterns along the band and a large rowel (the spiky wheel part) with eight long, narrow points. The attached leather strap, colored in different shades of brown and tan, has an oval design with layered bands of material, a decorative metal button or concho near its center, and what appears to be a small patch of animal fur incorporated into the design. The objects are centrally placed against a plain, off-white background, and there is no additional scenery or context present. The artist’s name, "EDWARD K. JEWETT," appears in small capital letters on the lower right side of the drawing.
title: Spur
